title: 第十五章 新债户博彩第二弹第十六章 望海楼
content_zh:
海州大街上。
黄土路面，两旁商铺林立。
看热闹的黎庶围得里三层外三层的。
不过，都被差役们挡在了圈外。
陆宁邀请了海州别驾李景爻、长史郑续做中人。
但周贡却好像希望围观的人越多越好，不但要在大街上和陆宁对赌，还一定要来市肆繁华之地，更大肆宣扬，引来了许多百姓看热闹。
陆宁也不多说，一副看你表演的样子。
“可以开始了吗？”陆宁摊开手，
周贡走路的姿势还是有些不雅，屁股一扭一扭的，走两步，就要倒吸口冷气。
他看着陆宁，却突然得意的笑了，说道：“东海公，咱们赌的就是，谁学狗最像！”
说完，他就“汪汪汪”叫了几声，然后，还吐出舌头，“哈……哈……哈……”学狗喘了几声粗气，倒真是惟妙惟肖。
甚至双手半举在胸前，学着狗直立踱步的样子，“哈……哈……”的，走了两步。
他屁股还痛，这么一扭一扭的，倒真像只瘸腿狗。
中人李景爻和郑续都怔住。
随之李景爻不禁暗中叫好，这周贡，竟然有此急智，不亏是司徒府出身，虽然只是个奴仆，却不简单啊！
周贡得意洋洋看向陆宁：“东海公！怎么样，认输吧？”
他心里，原本有些憋屈，如此大庭广众，又许多庶民面前学做狗，他虽然是奴，但一向走在外面威风八面，何时这样出过洋相？
不过，想到能令面前这蛮横霸道的东海国主认输，心里却又畅快难言。
有州府官员，更有无数草民围观，你这东海国主，难道真要学狗叫学狗喘气？传出去，不仅仅是你东海公，圣天子都会大没面子，定然见责。
而且你这有尊位的贵人，这辈子想迁升，都难了，只会成为京师贵胄们的笑柄。

甚至很可能过段时间，圣天子找个机会削了你的藩罢了你的爵，免得你以后再给本朝公侯丢脸。
我就如你说的一样，就是个“小奴”，出洋相就出吧，你咬我啊？！
周贡越想越是得意，只觉得这辈子自己都没这么威风过，让一个封国国主，二品尊位的贵人，在自己的面前吃瘪。
而且，爷是靠聪明机智赢的！
正是走上了人生巅峰。
看着周贡的表演，看着他的得意洋洋，陆宁也怔了下，随即好笑道：“你这小奴，倒是有几分小聪明！”
周贡冷哼一声，“东海公，既然认输，就此作罢，只是可惜了，本来，东海公还能拿到一万五千贯，一味逞强，鸡飞蛋打！”
啧啧的，一副为东海公惋惜的样子。
李景爻和郑续对望一眼，心说这司徒府奴役，太也不稳重，倒像是小号的东海公，不过身份比东海公差了十万八千里而已。
也幸好，没成东海公这种气候，不然，也是个让人头疼的主儿。
东海公今日算是遇到了比他更无赖的，输了也不冤。
其实除了派出人手逼着王吉还钱，陆宁也没做什么无赖的事，但他如同后世催债高利贷一样逼王吉还债的做法，以及在东海的作为在很多稳重官员看来就是胡作非为，这风评，渐渐传开。
海州官员，不知不觉就对这东海公，渐渐形成了某种认识上的共识。
content_en:
On Haizhou Street.
The loess road is lined with shops on both sides.
The Li Shu people watching the excitement were surrounded by three floors inside and three floors outside.
However, they were all blocked by the guards.
Lu Ning invited Haizhou Bijia Li Jingyao and Chang Shi Zheng Xu to be the middlemen.
But Zhou Gong seemed to hope that the more people would watch, the better. Not only did he want to gamble with Lu Ning on the street, but he also came to a prosperous place to publicize it even more, attracting many people to watch the excitement.
Lu Ning didn't say much, as if he was watching your performance.
"Can we start?" Lu Ning spread his hands,
Zhou Gong's walking posture was still a bit inelegant. He twisted his buttocks and took two steps before taking a breath of air.
He looked at Lu Ning and suddenly smiled proudly and said, "Donghai Gong, what we are betting on is who is the most like a dog!"
After saying that, he barked "woof, woof, woof" a few times, and then stuck out his tongue, "Ha... ha... ha..." The dog gasped a few times, which was really lifelike.
He even raised his hands half in front of his chest, imitating the upright pacing of a dog, saying "ha... ha..." and took two steps.
His butt still hurt, and he was squirming like a lame dog.
The middlemen, Li Jingyao and Zheng Xu, were both stunned.
Then Li Jingyao couldn't help but secretly applaud, Zhou Gong was so quick-witted, he was from the Situ Mansion. Although he was just a slave, he was not simple!
Zhou Gong looked at Lu Ning proudly: "Donghai Gong! What do you think, admit defeat?"
In his heart, he felt a little aggrieved. He was learning to be a dog in front of such a large public and many common people. Although he was a slave, he always walked in a dignified manner. When had he ever made a fool of himself like this?
However, the thought of being able to make the tyrannical Lord of the East China Sea in front of him admit defeat made him feel so happy that it was hard to express.
There are state officials and countless ordinary people watching. Do you, the Lord of the East China Sea, really want to bark like a dog and pant like a dog? If word spreads, not only you, Duke Donghai, but also the Holy Emperor will be greatly embarrassed and will definitely be held accountable.
Moreover, for a noble person like you, it will be difficult for you to get promoted in this life. You will only become the laughing stock of the nobles in the capital.
It is even very likely that after a while, the Holy Emperor will find an opportunity to cut off your vassal and your title, so that you will not embarrass the prince of this dynasty again in the future.
I'm just like you said, just a "little slave". Just make a fool of yourself. Are you going to bite me? !
The more Zhou Gong thought about it, the more proud he became. He felt that he had never been so majestic in his life, letting a second-grade nobleman, the lord of a feudal kingdom, be humbled in front of him.
Moreover, I won by being smart and witty!
It is reaching the pinnacle of life.
Seeing Zhou Gong's performance and his complacency, Lu Ning was startled for a moment, and then said with a smile: "You little slave, you are quite clever!"
Zhou Gong snorted coldly, "Donghai Gong, since you have admitted defeat, it is a pity to give up now. Originally, Donghai Gong could still get fifteen thousand guan, but he is just trying to be strong, and it is a waste!"
Tsk-tsk, as if feeling sorry for Duke Donghai.
Li Jingyao and Zheng Xu looked at each other and thought to themselves that this Situ Mansion slave was too unstable, more like a smaller Donghai Gong, but his identity was far different from Donghai Gong.
Fortunately, he didn't have the same climate as Donghai Gong, otherwise, he would also be a troublesome master.
Donghai Gong met a more scoundrel than him today, and he would not be unjust if he lost.
In fact, apart from sending people to force Wang Ji to repay the money, Lu Ning did not do anything rogue. However, his method of forcing Wang Ji to repay debts, like the debt collection loan sharks in later generations, and his actions in the East China Sea were regarded by many prudent officials as nonsense. This reputation gradually spread.
Haizhou officials, unknowingly, gradually formed a certain consensus on Donghai Gong.
